decisions.reason: As a door lever handle family close to the firm's core architectural hardware knowledge, it fits existing design, engineering and certification capabilities and is therefore relatively easy for the firm to refine and sustain commercially.

This door handle design is also close to the established offer, but as a more design-specific product rather than a broader system family it is somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning if demand is weaker than expected.

The electronic access system builds directly on the firm's move toward digital building organization, is presented as a flagship, and the firm's own R&D and system expertise give it strong absorptive capacity to learn from the launch and improve it further.
